newsitem.title: POLAND: Bank of NY to issue Polish funds GDRs - Warburg.
newsitem.headline: Bank of NY to issue Polish funds GDRs - Warburg.

text.p: The Bank of New York plans to issue Global Depositary Receipts (GDR), denominated in dollars, for the Polish National Investment Funds' (NFIs), an official of SBC Warburg, which organises the GDR trade, said on Monday.

Shares in the 15 NFIs, set up under the mass privatisation scheme, are due to enter the Warsaw bourse in the second or third quarter of 1997. Before, Poles will exchange their participation units in the scheme into the shares.

"The Bank of New York will issue GDRs for shares in individual funds," Warburg's director in charge of close-ended funds, John Korwin-Szymanowski, told Reuters. He added the GDRs would be created after the shares are listed in Warsaw.
On Friday, the participation units -- which are due to be exchanged into 15 shares, one in each fund -- started to trade as GDRs.
Under Poland's mass privatisaton NFI programme, shares in some 500 medium-size companies have been allocated to the 15 funds, which are run by foreign and domestic management firms. @
About 26 million Poles bought their participation unit for a nominal fee in a sale that ended last November.
